definition: ἀπο-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀποστέλλω), [in LXX: Deu.22:7, 3Ki.4:34 9:16 Psa.78:49, Ecc.8:8, Sng.4:13 (for שָׁלַח and its cognates), 1Es.9:51 Est.9:54, Jer.32:36, Bar.2:25, 1Ma.2:18, 2Ma.3:2 *.] __1. In cl., a sending away (MM, see word), as, an expedition (Hdt.).  __2. In LXX  __(a) discharge, dis­missal (Ecc.8:8);  __(b) a gift (3Ki.9:16, 1Ma.2:13).  __3. In NT, the office of an Apostle of Christ, apostleship: Act.1:25, Rom.1:5, 1Co.9:2, Gal.2:8 (Cremer, 530).† (AS)
